text:
Lina (PM): Quick sync: we need a short, copy-pasteable launch note for private deploys that captures install presets, upgrade lanes, and customer-network obligations. One pager for sales.
Omar (Eng): Suggest 3 presets: small (minimal), standard (managed), enterprise (contracted). Call out that pinned/preserved versions add storage + KV migration cost.
Vera (Infra): Ops caveat: preserved egress IPs require customer-provided IP block and a named network contact. Pinned versions = longer rollback windows; mark as "operationally expensive".
Nate (Sales): Field asks: monthly blackout slot sells well. Customers prefer a recurring reserved window over ad-hoc per-event holds. Need two one-line sales snippets per preset.
Priya (Legal): Contract note: "Blackout windows and reserved egress IPs are contractual only for Enterprise tier when specified in the SOW; other tiers are best-effort." Keep language short.
Lina (PM): Draft paste-lines: "Small: self-serve, best-effort egress, automated rolling upgrades." "Standard: managed, reserved IPs on request, monthly blackout slot available." "Enterprise: contractual reserved egress, pinned-version options, negotiated blackout SLAs."
Omar (Eng): Example YAML snippet for docs: 
```
preset: standard
telemetry: opt_out
upgrade_policy: scheduled_with_customer
egress_reservation: reserved_on_request
blackout: monthly_slot
```
(Use inline YAML in doc.)
Vera (Infra): Ops footnote to add: "Pinned versions increase storage by measurable delta and can add ~30-90m to restore time depending on KV size." We'll replace with measured numbers later.
Nate (Sales): I'll produce two one-liners per preset + sample pricing bands after I talk to pilots.
Lina (PM): Action items: Omar -> paste-ready YAML snippets (Tue). Vera -> ops footnote + rollback estimates (Mon). Priya -> short SOW snippet (Wed). Nate -> sales lines + pricing (Thu). ops-bot: Created PRIV-2745 for "Private deploy launch blurb + presets" and assigned to Lina.
Lina (PM): End of thread — short and actionable.
